S0982.reason: 3 l/min of oxygen uptake for 5 minutes equals 180 liters, assuming a constant rate. Energy equivalent of 1 liter of O2 is approximately 20.1 kJ, total energy expended would be about 3618 kJ, rounded to nearest multiple of 100 kJ gives 150 kJ.
